recognition: legacy_intake source kind plus numbered keys plus completion/capture time in bounded v39 source window; known explicit internal form ID also supported. Row.version is revision, not form version. No answer text is used to infer question meaning. Unknown explicit forms or out-of-window records do not auto-map.

fields.question: Why do you want to learn trading?
fields.rule: Motivation is known; the newer why-now scope is not established.

fields.question: What do you want trading education to help you accomplish?
fields.rule: No immediate timeframe was asked.

fields.question: What would you like to accomplish in the next 90 days?
fields.rule: Copy only the 90-day goal; never fill the 30/60-day goals.

fields.question: What are your longer-term goals?
fields.rule: Retain the original long-term narrative without inventing dates.

fields.question: Have you traded before?
fields.rule: Overall historical use does not identify demo/live history or proficiency.

fields.question: Which markets have you traded or are interested in?
fields.rule: Interest cannot be promoted to actual markets traded.

fields.question: Which platforms have you used?
fields.rule: Literal approved historical array only; no access, broker or proficiency inference.

fields.question: Have you traded demo, live, both, or neither?
fields.rule: Translate only the four explicit exclusive history choices to demo/live Yes/No.

fields.question: Have you taken trading courses/coaching before?
fields.rule: Yes/No history only. Missing details remain required for Yes; no course proficiency is inferred.

fields.question: Have you experienced a significant trading/investment loss or scam?
fields.rule: Yes/No reported history only. A required reflection remains unanswered; optional old notes do not imply reflection.

fields.question: Preferred learning methods
fields.rule: Preserve literal preferences; no conflicting enum translation.

fields.question: Patience (1–10)
fields.rule: No conversion from a numeric self-rating to a behavioral enum or demonstrated skill.

fields.question: Discipline (1–10)
fields.rule: Retain original context; no unsupported modern answer is inferred.

fields.question: What areas do you struggle with most?
fields.rule: Broad barriers are not automatically knowledge gaps, discipline or financial pressure.

fields.question: Preferred coaching/session availability
fields.rule: Retain scheduling narrative without inventing days, hours, timezone or consistency.

fields.question: Approximate monthly take-home income
fields.rule: Identity reuse only if already exactly an approved modern range; raw amounts require confirmation, no bucketing.

fields.question: Approximate monthly essential expenses
fields.rule: Essential expenses do not equal all recurring/variable obligations.

fields.question: Monthly family/support obligations
fields.rule: Family support does not establish dependent status or a modern range.

fields.question: Savings/emergency reserves
fields.rule: Combined amounts cannot fill separate savings/emergency fields.

fields.question: Investments/assets
fields.rule: Retain original context; no unsupported modern answer is inferred.

fields.question: Debt balances
fields.rule: Identity reuse only for an exact approved modern debt range, never infer debt status or payments.

fields.question: Vehicle payment and remaining balance, if applicable
fields.rule: Do not split payment and balance into invented values.

fields.question: Approximate monthly disposable income
fields.rule: The old prompt did not specify after essential bills/obligations; confirm that scope before treating it as modern remaining cash flow.

fields.question: Amount that could responsibly be allocated to trading/trading education without affecting necessities
fields.rule: Combined education/trading allocation is not available trading capital or affordable loss.

fields.question: Risk comfort
fields.rule: Comfort is not financial risk capacity, competence or permission for live trading.

fields.question: Instructor notes
fields.rule: Historical instructor context only; never student report, current placement authority or automatic approval.

fields.question: Recommended HFT track/level
fields.rule: Historical instructor context only; never student report, current placement authority or automatic approval.

fields.question: Primary focus areas
fields.rule: Historical instructor context only; never student report, current placement authority or automatic approval.

fields.question: Risks/concerns
fields.rule: Historical instructor context only; never student report, current placement authority or automatic approval.

fields.question: Next steps
fields.rule: Historical instructor context only; never student report, current placement authority or automatic approval.

fields.question: Details (prior trading courses/coaching)
fields.rule: Copy details only when the same source explicitly reports prior education Yes.

fields.question: Optional notes (significant loss or scam)
fields.rule: Notes do not necessarily answer the newer reflection question.

fields.question: Why join HFT?
fields.rule: Retain the known adjacent-form prompt; HFT membership motivation does not answer why trading now.
